name: Open-Platypus
description: Open-Platypus is a curated dataset subset of other open datasets released to support fine-tuning and merging of LoRA modules for Large Language Models (LLMs). It enables quick, cheap, and powerful refinement of LLMs, achieving strong performance on quantitative LLM metrics with relatively small data and compute resources.
reputation: Widely circulated in the open LLM fine-tuning community as a compact instruction-tuning/merge dataset, especially for low-cost LoRA experimentation.
notes: Dataset is a subset of other open datasets; released publicly; enables efficient fine-tuning and merging of LLMs.
